title: A farmer's barley and wheat choices
body: A farmer has a fixed piece of land, and limited water and labour. The land can be used to grow barley, wheat or a mix of both. The possible combinations when all resources are used efficiently are: A - 0 kg barley and 100 kg wheat; B - 25 kg barley and 90 kg wheat; C - 50 kg barley and 70 kg wheat; D - 75 kg barley and 40 kg wheat; E - 100 kg barley and 0 kg wheat. When these points are plotted with barley on the x-axis and wheat on the y-axis, they form a downward sloping Production Possibility Curve (PPC). Every point on the curve shows the maximum output possible without wastage.
